title: Selective publication of antidepressant trials and its influence on apparent efficacy
authors: Turner EH, Matthews AM, Linardatos E, Tell RA, Rosenthal R
population: Placebo-controlled short-term trials of 12 antidepressants approved by the FDA between 1987 and 2004
authorConflicts: Turner reported having served as a medical reviewer for the Food and Drug Administration.
result: Of 74 FDA-registered trials, 23 (31%), with 3449 participants, were not published. 48 of 51 published trials (94%) were reported as positive, against 38 of 74 (51%) in the FDA analysis. Journal-based effect sizes exceeded FDA-based effect sizes by 32% overall and by 11% to 69% for individual drugs.
